title: The violinist Dominguez compared to others
summary: Dominguez was a jazz violinist, not in the class of the older violinists, and played with Milton's band.

story.theme_name: Banjo, guitar and the rhythm section: instruments and players
story.community_name: Fiddlers and reading violinists of New Orleans

blocks.x: I want to ask you, how was Domenkis who played violin, how was he compared to Peter on and Dennis Dore, the old man Rocha?

He wasn't in their class, no. He was like a jazz violin player, something like Willie. That's all I was with Saeed, Willie Durner was. Playin' the thing he helped. He could read too, but I mean that'd be most of you and I could play that. The jazz violin. And Paul Delingrich. Yeah. That's when old man Piku was playin' with me and Johnny Deeb, I mean all that. We had a band together that time. We played the autographs at that time.
